svg.title: The karate club: the real split against three methods
svg.desc: Four panels of the same 34-member network. Shape is the side each member took. Colour is the group a method found. A heavy black outline marks members the method puts on the wrong side.
svg.text: no member is misclassified by definition
Circles stayed with Mr. Hi (member 1). Squares followed the officer (member 34). Dashed lines: ties that cross groups.
